candidates.change_summary: Change return value from true to false.
Delete the require statement that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing calls with empty arrays to succeed.
Delete the inner require(_s) inside the for-loop body, causing the function to return true even when an external call fails.
Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' so the function always returns false after execution.
Replace 'require(_s);' with 'require(!_s);' forcing revert when the external call succeeds and allowing execution to continue on failure (though any failure causes revert, so behavior changes).
Replace the bytes4 function selector id with a different function, e.g. 'transfer(address,uint256)', changing which external function is called.
Replace 'caddress.call(...)' with 'delegatecall(...)', preserving same arguments but changing call context and return data handling, thus altering observable effects on the caller's state.
